description: This file implements Wi-Fi CSI (Channel State Information) related functionalities including session management, client MAC address handling, event processing, inter-process communication via FIFOs, and RBUS interface handlers for configuration and control within a Wi-Fi management application.

methods.name: void csi_disable_client(csi_session_t * r_csi)
methods.description: Disables CSI collection for clients in a session when they are disconnected or no longer monitored, stopping ongoing CSI data collection for specific MAC addresses.

methods.name: csi_session_t * csi_get_session(bool create,int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing CSI session by session number or creates a new one if requested and allowed.

methods.name: void csi_update_client_mac_status(mac_addr_t mac,bool connected,int ap_idx)
methods.description: Updates the connection status of a client MAC address in all CSI sessions, starting or stopping CSI collection accordingly.

methods.name: void csi_set_client_mac(char * r_mac_list,int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Sets client MAC addresses for a CSI session, enabling or disabling CSI collection for specified clients.

methods.name: void csi_enable_client(csi_session_t * csi)
methods.description: Enables CSI for a session's clients that are connected and should be monitored, starting CSI collection as needed.

methods.name: void csi_enable_session(bool enable,int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Enables or disables an entire CSI session based on session number.

methods.name: void csi_enable_subscription(bool subscribe,int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to CSI data for a session, managing ongoing data collection.

methods.name: void csi_create_session(int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Creates a new CSI session with specified session number.

methods.name: void csi_set_interval(int interval,int csi_session_number)
methods.description: Sets the reporting interval for CSI data collection in a session.

methods.name: int push_csi_data_dml_to_ctrl_queue(queue_t * csi_queue)
methods.description: Encodes and pushes CSI data queue into the control system's web configuration queue.

methods.name: void csi_del_session(int csi_sess_number)
methods.description: Deletes a CSI session, removing its FIFO, stopping data collection, and cleaning resources.

methods.name: queue_t * update_csi_local_queue_from_motion_queue()
methods.description: Creates a local copy of the current CSI data queue for processing.

methods.name: rbusError_t csi_table_addrowhandler(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * tableName,char const * aliasName,uint32_t * instNum)
methods.description: Handles adding a new CSI session row in RBUS, creating a new CSI session and managing the queue.

methods.name: rbusError_t csi_table_removerowhandler(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * rowName)
methods.description: Handles removing a CSI session row in RBUS, deleting the session and cleaning queue entries.

methods.name: rbusError_t csi_set_handler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusSetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: RBUS set handler to configure CSI sessions, including client MAC list, enable/disable, and subscription handling.

methods.name: rbusError_t csi_get_handler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: RBUS get handler to retrieve CSI session data, client MAC list, enable state, and session count.

methods.name: int webconfig_hal_csi_apply(webconfig_subdoc_decoded_data_t * data)
methods.description: Applies new web configuration for CSI, updating sessions, clients, and enabling/disabling collection.

methods.name: int webconfig_event_motion(wifi_app_t * apps,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * data)
methods.description: Processes web configuration events for CSI and other Wi-Fi features.

methods.name: void motion_assoc_device_event(wifi_app_t * apps,void * data)
methods.description: Handles a device association event, updating CSI client MAC status.

methods.name: void motion_disassoc_device_event(wifi_app_t * apps,void * data)
methods.description: Handles a device disassociation event, updating CSI client MAC status.

methods.name: int hal_event_motion(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * data)
methods.description: Handles HAL level motion events, including device association/disassociation.

methods.name: int do_pipe_publish(char * buffer,size_t len,csi_session_t * csi)
methods.description: Publishes CSI data through FIFO pipe to external consumer.

methods.name: void motion_csi_publish(mac_address_t mac_address,wifi_csi_dev_t * csi_dev_data,csi_session_t * csi)
methods.description: Constructs and sends CSI data over FIFO pipe.

methods.name: void process_csi_data(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_csi_dev_t * csi_dev_data)
methods.description: Processes incoming CSI data, matching with sessions and publishing if appropriate.

methods.name: int process_csi_stop_motion(wifi_app_t * app)
methods.description: Stops CSI data collection for active sessions.

methods.name: int process_csi_start_motion(wifi_app_t * app)
methods.description: Starts CSI data collection for active sessions, issuing start commands to clients.

methods.name: int motion_event_csi(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_csi_dev_t * csi)
methods.description: Handles incoming CSI data events, invoking processing routines.

methods.name: int motion_event_speed_test(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,void * data)
methods.description: Handles speed test events, pausing/resuming CSI collection accordingly.

methods.name: int motion_event(wifi_app_t * app,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Main handler for various motion-related events, threads synchronization, and event dispatch.

methods.name: int motion_start_fn(void * wifi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Stub function to start motion-related CSI collection.

methods.name: int motion_stop_fn(void * wifi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Stub function to stop motion-related CSI collection.

methods.name: int motion_init(wifi_app_t * app,unsigned int create_flag)
methods.description: Initializes the motion app, registers RBUS data elements, creates piped communication, and sets up session queues.
